evidence.note: Reported 2025 accounting losses meet the numerical threshold, but nonrecurring charges and differing loss measures prevent inferring equivalent cash needs or industry dependence.
The reported annual figures differ sharply across net loss, operating loss, and cash outflow. Later cash-flow information cannot establish the financing counterfactual at publication.

reviews.rationale: Headline accounting losses are consistent with the numerical premise, but do not establish matching cash funding needs. The packet lacks industry-wide denominators and evidence that continued fundraising sustains most revenue and compute demand. It also does not disprove that dependence.
